title: Controlled remote viewing created by Ingo Swann and used by the military; stages 8 through 18 not taught to the public

tellings.quote:
created by Inga Swan and used by the
military for all those years for
intelligence collection now being used
for businesses

plain: Controlled remote viewing is described as a method of trying to sense distant places or hidden things with the mind alone. Lyn Buchanan, a former Army sergeant who says he practised it himself, tells Michels it was created by a man named Ingo Swann and used by the military for intelligence gathering for many years. He says businesses use it now, but stages 8 through 18 of the method are not taught to the public.
